GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Straight Out The Back 9-10 Lengths Clear All The Way Could Not Get Close At Any Stage - # same throughout

Slow out 1 length then Restrained and Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, railed up middle stages, shifted out approaching home turn when awkwardly placed on heels, trailed 5 Lengths Two Wide turning, hooked wider Straightening Up and made up a couple of lengths in Straight # never a factor
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Approaching the home turn became awkwardly placed on heels, obliging to shift out, shortly thereafter raced in restricted room and momentarily steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Little Slow Out Not Bustled Settled Down 4th Outside 2 Lengths No Pace On quickly improved Lead 2 Lengths x 800m, led x 1 Lengths @ 600m, Ridden Along Straightening Up challenged @ 200m Kept Finding - # smart ride

Jumped okay & Settled Down 5.5 Lengths Two Wide , raced same middle stages, shifted wider 500m, trailed 6 Lengths 3 Wide turning, carried wider on turn then ran on and Made Ground in Straight # ran on ok
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Approaching the 500m, momentarily steadied and shifted out into clear running to avoid heels. Round home turn was carried wider. When under pressure in the straight laid in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped ok Hard Ridden to stay there settled down third last fence 5-6 Lengths (1400m), going ok 600 shuffled back briefly before Turn , Straightened Up 4 Lengths away Clear only wacking away though, into second last 100m or So # stuck to task
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 500m, raced in restricted room and steadied. Shifted in over the final 100m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 3.5 Lengths on fence, railed up to 2.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn then blocked initially on straightening, followed leader working into race, weakened from the 175m laying out from there to line. (Nose Roll OFF FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie AGAIN) [Stewards: App. jockey reported it never travelled comfortably, wanted to lay in under pressure in straight and was disappointing.] # Had some excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr reported that the gelding never travelled comfortably, wanted to lay in under pressure in the straight and was disappointing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 7 Lengths on fence, Made Some Ground to Turn then Hooked Out to 6 Lengths 3 Wide , Made Some Ground in Straight however went to line not fully tested. # Wide from the turn
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Became awkwardly placed on heels near the 800m. Laid in under pressure down the running shifting in & bumping near the 100m & again near the 50m when attempting a narrow run. Went to the line without being fully tested.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly then dropped straight back (-1.5 lengths), Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, railed up to 4 Lengths turning, blocked on straightening then made a little ground in straight. (Blinkers ON) # slow early
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Improved onto heels approaching the 400m having to be steadied. Disappointed for a run on entering the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down last 9 Lengths from the lead, Made Some Ground to 6 Lengths Two Wide turning, Held Ground in straight. (Blinkers OFF FIRST TIME, Nose Roll FIRST TIME, Tongue Tie OFF FIRST TIME) # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Laid in under pressure in the home straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length and Settled Down 4 Lengths on fence, little change to 3.5 Lengths rail turning, couldn't improve in Straight # no excuses
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly and lost ground. Approaching the 800m, when the pace of the race slackened, improved onto heels & steadied.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Settled Down 3 Lengths on fence, Drifted Back to 6 Lengths turning, Held Ground in Straight # Had its chances
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Had some difficulty obtaining clear running near the 200m. Laid in under pressure in the home straight.
